title: The watchtower
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
Ask whether Dask can see you.
starting_code:
# Ask which way Dask faces with print.
# Ask whether he can see you with print.
# Then walk past him.
hints: You must ask two questions using `print` before you walk.
Give `dask.facing` to `print` to see which way Dask looks.
Give `dask.can_see(wizard)` to `print` to see if he spots you. Then move right six times.
intro: Look, {wizard}. Dask is staring at the wall. Let us ask if he can see us.
outro: He did not see us! That was close.
learned: Now you know how to ask a question, which programmers call an expression.
